## Changes: ### Bugs: * #4628: Fix Gemini 400 errors from orphaned tool calls during conversation summarization ### Others: * #4629: Sessions: fixes for detect PR * #4570: Exclude a few more schemes by default * #4643: nes: cursor jump: increase current file max tokens budget to 3K from 2K * #4641: Add rate limit time * #4608: Set up experiment for `prompt_cache_key` in Responses API * #4640: Background - create temp index files in the global storage directory * #4637: Update github copilot npm
See More * #4636: Enhance CopilotCLISessionService with session ID management and tests * #4609: nes: telemetry: fix: set correct stateless telemetry for first edit coming from NES * #4635: Separate implementation of Copilot CLI, controller vs old API * #4634: Sessions - get diff stats for untracked changes * #4627: Revert setting NeedsInput status for Copilot CLI * #4603: Copilot CLI - enhance chat request handling with mode instructions * #4632: Git - move IGitService from vscode to vscode-node * #4620: Background - fix "Apply" button * #4568: Add telemetry on file counts for external ingest * #4621: Make output channel logging resilient to shutdown * #4619: Sessions - refactoring how changes are computed when auto-commit is disabled * #4617: Update description for forking copilot cli sessions * #4616: fix: show hook details in debug panel for background CopilotCLI agent * #4614: Ensure claude code respects model picker * #4612: Add configuration and support for CLI fork sessions in Copilot * #4607: Sessions - fix issuee related to git state * #4606: fixes https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/300772 * #4604: update version to 0.42 This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=423596&view=logs).
